While llg_001 'Select pickup time slot' and llg_002 'Receive pickup reminder notification' are relevant, llg_003 'Receive missed pickup notification' does not adequately address the consequences of missing a pickup. The parent HLG emphasizes handling forfeit policies, which is currently unsupported. Moreover, there is no LLG documenting the enforcement of these policies or the update to the customer's fair-play score upon forfeiture.

The LLGs also lack documentation on system interactions related to store employee visibility of pickup schedules and confirmation of order collections. These are crucial for maintaining system reliability, as outlined in the parent HLG.

Lastly, there is no LLG addressing the communication between the system and farmers regarding product delivery times, which is indirectly mentioned in the source but not explicitly represented in the current decomposition.

In summary, while some aspects of the parent HLG are covered, several essential capabilities are missing or inadequately represented, necessitating a regeneration of the LLGs to fully realize the parent HLG.
